title: Carrow Coast Almanac — Fernhaven Seed Library
text: The Fernhaven Seed Library is a community seed-lending collection founded in 2014 and housed in the former lifeboat station on Quay Street, Fernhaven. Its catalogue holds more than eight hundred vegetable, herb and flower varieties, and its Seedling Swap each April is among the town's larger spring events. Borrowing is free; members return seed saved from their own crops.
